defs.def: a large building or covered area that has many shops/stores, restaurants, etc. inside it 购物商场；购物广场

ex.s: Explore the monuments and memorials on the National Mall as your guide shares unique facts and history at each stop.
ex.t: 当导游在每一站分享独特的事实和历史时，探索国家广场上的纪念碑和纪念物。

ex.s: Get up close to the monuments and memorials as your bike the sites of Capitol Hill and the National Mall.
ex.t: 当你骑行经过国会山和国家广场的景点时，可以近距离观赏那些纪念碑和纪念建筑。

ex.s: It would be turned into a modern shopping mall.
ex.t: 它将被改造成一个现代化的购物中心。

ex.s: The resulting story in the local newspaper divided the people of the town: some were in favour of the new shopping mall, and some were against it.
ex.t: 当地报纸上刊登的报道使镇上的人产生了分歧：一些人支持新建购物中心，另一些人则反对。

ex.s: Since it can be too cold to go outdoors, Edmonton is home to many shopping malls.
ex.t: 因为外面太冷了，埃德蒙顿拥有许多购物中心。

ex.s: In fact, one of the largest shopping malls in North America is in Edmonton.
ex.t: 事实上，北美最大的购物中心之一就在埃德蒙顿。
